description: We're Field Force, a team of motivated students interested in space, technology, science, and innovation. We enjoy problem-solving, coding, researching, and developing creative solutions. We're looking for passionate teammates with skills in programming, data analysis, graphic design, research, or science. You don't need to be an expert, just creative, motivated, and willing to work as a team!
summary: To combat the issue of handicapped people who are not able to understand and interpret data about Earth, such as rising global temperatures, our team decided to code an interactive website that transforms Earth data into audible sounds for the user to hear. Instead of relying  solely on visual representations such as graphs, maps, and satellite imagery, our platform uses sonification to transform environmental data into audible experiences. By allowing users to hear patterns and changes in Earth's systems, our project provides an alternative way to explore and understand our planet. This project is important because understanding our planet should not be limited by vision. We believe that Earth science should be experienced by everyone, and our Earth Jukebox interface makes that possible by turning real world data into audible noises.
details: Our interactive website Earth Jukebox turns NASA Earth data from a 3-D globe into sound. Users can explore environmental changes like temperature, Carbon Dioxide emissions, and weather patterns through visuals and audio. Our goal is to make data about Earth more accessible, especially for people with visual impairments. We used a laptop that ran Visual Studio Code and OpenAI Codex, while using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.JS, TypeScript, JSON, and other coding languages to develop the website. By using a 3-D globe with a list of datasets to choose from, our project transforms scientific data into a multisensory experience. Our team focused on accessibility, accuracy, performance, and making the website easy to use so that anyone can understand how Earth is changing.
